sop_modules.name: Exterior Siding Protection & Equipment Setup
sop_modules.description: Deploy landscape/hardscape protection, mask fixtures, set up access equipment and spray rigs. Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility — belongs in window/door specs (RC-001).

tasks.name: Landscape Protection Setup
tasks.description: Deploy tarps and drop cloths over landscape beds, shrubs, and plants adjacent to siding work area. Full cover for spray, edge tarps for brush/roll.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of plantings within spray drift zone. Secure tarps against wind.

tasks.name: Hardscape Protection Setup
tasks.description: Deploy drop cloths and plastic over walkways, patios, and driveways adjacent to siding.

quality_notes.all: Tape plastic to foundation at grade line. Extend coverage to drip/overspray zone.

tasks.name: Fixture and Utility Masking
tasks.description: Mask exterior light fixtures, house numbers, utility panels, hose bibs. Bag and tape HVAC units if adjacent.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of all fixtures and utility connections on working elevation.

tasks.name: Spray Equipment Setup
tasks.description: Set up ladders, scaffold, or lift per access_type. Configure airless sprayer, hoses, tips for siding application. Stage materials.

quality_notes.all: Verify tip size for primer vs finish. Stage enough material for full elevation run.

tasks.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
tasks.description: Set up ladders, scaffold, or lift per access_type. Stage brushes, rollers, trays, and materials.

quality_notes.all: Stage enough material for full elevation run.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Landscape/hardscape protection first → Fixture masking → Equipment setup last.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Siding Surface Preparation
sop_modules.description: Substrate-state-driven prep sequence. NC bare wood: sand mill glaze, back-prime, end-seal, knot-prime, caulk. Repaint: power wash, scrape, sand. Tasks activate/deactivate based on substrate_state.

tasks.name: Power Wash Siding
tasks.description: Pressure wash siding to remove dirt, chalk, mildew, and loose paint. Required for all repaint substrate states. Not typically needed for NC bare wood.

quality_notes.all: 2000-2500 PSI. 15° tip. Maintain 12-18 inch distance. Allow 24-48 hr dry time before coating.

tasks.name: Scrape Loose Paint
tasks.description: Hand-scrape all loose, cracking, and peeling paint. Feather edges of remaining sound paint for smooth transition.

quality_notes.QT3: Remove all loose paint. Feather edges.
quality_notes.QT4: Remove all loose paint. Feather edges to smooth profile.
quality_notes.QT5: Remove all loose paint. Feather to invisible transition. May require heat gun for stubborn areas.

tasks.name: Sand Mill Glaze Removal
tasks.description: Sand all exposed siding faces with 80-120 grit to remove mill glaze. Mill glaze on new lumber prevents primer adhesion. 100% coverage required.

quality_notes.QT3: Full coverage sand. Check for missed glaze zones.
quality_notes.QT4: Full coverage. Inspect at 3 ft for uniform scratch pattern.
quality_notes.QT5: Full coverage. Inspect under raking light for missed areas.

tasks.name: Sand for Adhesion
tasks.description: Light sand existing coating for mechanical adhesion. 120-150 grit. For repaint and factory-primed substrates.

quality_notes.all: Light scuff. Not removing material — creating tooth for adhesion.

tasks.name: Back-Prime Rear Faces
tasks.description: Apply primer to rear/hidden face of siding boards. Prevents moisture absorption from behind. Done on ground before installation or from behind if accessible.

quality_notes.all: 100% coverage on rear face. Single coat sufficient. Prevents cupping and moisture-driven failure.

tasks.name: End-Seal Cut Edges
tasks.description: Brush sealant/primer on all cut end grain. End grain absorbs moisture 10-20x faster than face grain.

quality_notes.all: Every cut edge sealed. Joints, miters, butt joints, and field cuts.

tasks.name: Spot-Prime Knots
tasks.description: Apply shellac-based or oil-based knot sealer to all visible knots. Prevents tannin and resin bleed-through.

quality_notes.QT3: All visible knots sealed. One coat.
quality_notes.QT4: All knots sealed. Two coats on large/pitch knots.
quality_notes.QT5: All knots sealed. Two coats all knots.

tasks.name: Caulk Gaps and Joints
tasks.description: Apply exterior paintable caulk to siding-to-trim joints, board joints, and gaps.

quality_notes.QT3: All open joints and gaps caulked. Smooth tool.
quality_notes.QT4: All joints caulked with consistent bead. Tool smooth.
quality_notes.QT5: All joints caulked. Precision bead. Inspect for uniformity.

tasks.name: Prep Dust Cleanup
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from all surfaces before coating.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed. Wipe test on random boards shows clean surface.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Power wash (repaint) → Scrape (failing/peeling) → Sand (mill glaze or adhesion) → Back-prime (bare wood) → End-seal (bare wood) → Knot-prime (bare wood) → Caulk → Dust cleanup.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Siding Field Prime Coat
sop_modules.description: Full field prime coat. Required for bare wood, factory-primed, chalking, failing, peeling, weathered, and semi-stain states. Spot prime only for sound paint. Not required for solid stain (if compatible topcoat).

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Spray Application
tasks.description: Apply full prime coat by airless spray. Even, consistent mil thickness across all siding field.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. No holidays or thin spots.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform mil build. Inspect for coverage at 3 ft.
quality_notes.QT5: Perfect uniformity. Inspect under raking light.

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Backroll After Spray
tasks.description: Immediately backroll sprayed primer into substrate for better penetration and film adhesion. Required on porous wood substrates.

quality_notes.all: Work primer into grain. No drips or sags. Keep wet edge.

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Apply full prime coat by brush and roller. Brush for edges, transitions. Roller for open field.

quality_notes.all: Work primer into grain. Even coverage. No holidays.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Single prime coat. Method determined by application_method dimension. Substrate state determines whether full prime, spot prime, or skip (sound paint with compatible existing coating).

sop_modules.name: Exterior Siding Finish Coat 1
sop_modules.description: First finish coat application on primed siding.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Application
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat by airless spray. Consistent mil build, uniform coverage.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. No drips or holidays.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform mil build. No visible spray pattern at 3 ft.
quality_notes.QT5: Perfect uniformity. No defects at arm's length.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Backroll After Spray
tasks.description: Backroll sprayed finish coat for uniform texture and enhanced adhesion.

quality_notes.all: Even roller texture. No drips. Maintain wet edge.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat by brush and roller.

quality_notes.all: Even coverage. No brush marks in roller field. Maintain wet edge.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: First finish coat. Allow recoat time per product TDS before interstage/coat 2.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Siding Interstage Inspection
sop_modules.description: Inspect first finish coat, touch up defects. Light sand at QT4+ only.

tasks.name: Interstage Inspection
tasks.description: Inspect first finish coat for holidays, runs, sags, and coverage defects.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick scan for obvious defects — runs, sags, holidays.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection at 6 ft viewing distance. Mark all visible defects.
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough inspection at arm's length. Mark every imperfection.

tasks.name: Interstage Light Sand
tasks.description: Light sand between finish coats for mechanical adhesion. 150-220 grit. QT4+ only.

quality_notes.QT4: Light scuff sand. Remove nibs and defects.
quality_notes.QT5: Full light sand. Uniform scratch pattern.

tasks.name: Interstage Touch-Up
tasks.description: Repair defects found during inspection.

quality_notes.QT4: Fix all defects found during inspection.
quality_notes.QT5: Fix every marked defect. Blend repairs.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Sand (QT4+ only) → Touch up → Coat 2.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Application
tasks.description: Apply second finish coat by airless spray. Final coat — critical for appearance and film build.

quality_notes.QT4: Uniform mil build. No visible pattern at 6 ft.
quality_notes.QT5: Perfect uniformity. No defects at arm's length.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Backroll After Spray
tasks.description: Backroll final sprayed finish coat for uniform texture.

quality_notes.all: Even texture. No drips. Final appearance coat.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Apply second finish coat by brush and roller. Final coat.

quality_notes.all: Even coverage. No brush marks. Maintain wet edge to lap line.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Siding Final Inspection
sop_modules.description: Final walkthrough of completed siding finish. Touch up defects.

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
tasks.description: Walk all elevations and inspect finished siding.

quality_notes.QT3: Ground-level walkthrough at 6-10 ft viewing distance.
quality_notes.QT4: Ground-level with binoculars for upper elevations. 6 ft standard.
quality_notes.QT5: Scaffold/lift inspection of all elevations at arm's length.

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during final inspection.

quality_notes.QT4: Fix all noted defects. Blend seamlessly.
quality_notes.QT5: Fix every defect. Blend at arm's length standard.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect all elevations → Touch up → Sign off.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Siding Cleanup & Protection Teardown
sop_modules.description: Remove all protection materials, clean spray equipment, restore site.

tasks.name: Protection Material Removal
tasks.description: Remove all masking tape, landscape tarps, hardscape covers, fixture bags.

quality_notes.all: Check for residue. Remove all tape and plastic completely.

tasks.name: Clean Spray Equipment
tasks.description: Flush airless sprayer, clean tips, coil hoses. Clean brushes and rollers.

quality_notes.all: Full flush cycle. Tips cleaned and stored.

tasks.name: Site Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Collect all debris — sandpaper, caulk tubes, tape, containers. Leave site clean.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Protection teardown → Equipment cleaning → Site cleanup.
